notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with Derevi.
description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery by tapping it, adding {5}.
Activate Derevi by paying {2}, blinking itself.
Derevi enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability.
Resolve the Derevi trigger, untapping Chromatic Orrery.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Derevi.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Chromatic Orrery's last ability to draw infinite cards.
